title: Role of the Neonatal Fc Receptor for IgG in the Pathophysiology of Lupus
brief_summary: This study evaluates the expression of the neonatal fc receptor (FcRn) in white blood cells and antigen-presenting cells (APC) in active lupus patients compared to inactive lupus patients and control to investigate if it's upregulated or not.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion criteria:

* Lupus erythematosus newly diagnosed or active
* Inactive lupus erythematosus
* Needing a blood sample for diagnosis or follow up
* Signed informed consent

Exclusion criteria:

* Other auto immune disease
* Pregnant or brest feeding
* Legal protection or protected adults
study_population: All patient included are hospitalised in the university hospital of Tours in France
